description_en: Queries BGP peers in a specified region
description_zh: 调用DescribeBgpPeers接口查询指定地域下的BGP邻居
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-bgp-peers --router-id vbr-2zecmmvg5gvu8i4te0000 --bgp-peer-id bgp-2ze3un0ft1jd1xd0000 --bgp-group-id bgpg-2zev8h2wo414sfh0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --is-default false --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBgpPeers

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Virtual Border Router (VBR) associated with the BGP peer that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的BGP邻居关联的VBR ID
parameters.name: router_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the BGP peer that you want to query
parameters.name: bgp_peer_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the BGP group to which the BGP peer that you want to query belongs
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的BGP邻居所在BGP组的ID
parameters.name: bgp_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the BGP group to which the BGP peer that you want to query belongs. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的BGP邻居所在BGP组的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:

true: The BGP group is the default BGP group.

false: The BGP group is not the default BGP group
